ansp.app.title: {name} supervisor console
ansp.app.tagline: Dynamic airspace restrictions in U-space airspace
ansp.footer.no_command: This console never commands an aircraft.
ansp.locale.label: Language
ansp.scope_notice: Restrictions are planned, activated, extended, ended and cancelled through the API, which judges them and sends them to the CISP and the DSS. This console shows what the API says.
ansp.nav.label: Console
ansp.account.sign_out_failed: Sign-out did not reach the console; try again.
ansp.status.label: Stream status
ansp.status.cis_none: No CIS projection yet: no restriction can be placed
ansp.status.signed_out: Signed out: your session has ended.
ansp.problem.unreachable: The console could not reach the API. Nothing was changed.
ansp.problem.forbidden: Your role may not do this.
ansp.problem.cis_stale: The CIS projection is stale or missing: the API places no restriction until it is current.
ansp.problem.truncated: The API listed more problems than it sends; the list is cut.
ansp.action.reason_too_long: The reason is longer than {max} characters.
ansp.login.intro: Sign in with your console account. Every role signs in with a one-time code from an authenticator app.
ansp.login.title: Sign in
ansp.login.enrol: Your account has no authenticator yet. Scan this code with an authenticator app, or enter the key, then type the code it shows.
ansp.login.enrol_qr: QR code of the authenticator enrolment
ansp.login.wait: Wait {seconds} s before the next try.
ansp.login.problem.invalid_credentials: The username or the password is wrong.
ansp.login.problem.mfa_refused: The code is wrong or was used already.
ansp.login.problem.account_locked: The account is locked for now after too many failures.
ansp.login.problem.invalid_request: The sign-in was not in the form the API takes.
ansp.login.problem.validation: Enter the username and the password, or the code.
ansp.login.problem.unavailable: The console cannot sign you in now: the API or the console is unavailable.
ansp.login.problem.mfa_challenge_missing: The password step expired: sign in again from the start.
ansp.login.problem.origin_refused: Sign-in is accepted only from this console's own address.
ansp.login.problem.bff_unavailable: The console is not configured for sign-in.
ansp.login.problem.upstream_unreachable: The console could not reach the API.
ansp.login.problem.upstream_timeout: The API did not answer in time.
ansp.login.problem.upstream_invalid: The API's answer was not one the console understands.

ansp.restrictions.cis: Placed against CIS version {version}; projection age {age} s
ansp.restrictions.cis_none: No CIS projection yet: the API places no restriction until it has one
ansp.restrictions.none: No restrictions: the API holds none.
ansp.restrictions.truncated: The API cut the list; narrow it by state.

ansp.delivery.cisp.not_yet_since: CISP: v{version} not yet published since {since}
ansp.delivery.cisp.behind: CISP: holds v{published}; v{version} not yet published
ansp.delivery.cisp.behind_since: CISP: holds v{published}; v{version} not yet published since {since}
ansp.delivery.cisp.failed: CISP: v{version} refused (HTTP {code}) at {at}; not retried
ansp.delivery.cisp.abandoned: CISP: v{version} not delivered after {attempts} attempts (retry window over at {at})
ansp.delivery.dss.failed: DSS: refused since {since}; see the alarm
ansp.delivery.uss_notify.abandoned: USSPs: notification not delivered after {attempts} attempts
ansp.delivery.direct_degraded.queued: Direct delivery to the USSPs and the authority (CISP not reached): queued
ansp.delivery.direct_degraded.sent: Direct delivery to the USSPs and the authority (CISP not reached): sent at {at}
ansp.delivery.direct_degraded.failed: Direct delivery to the USSPs and the authority: refused (HTTP {code}) at {at}
ansp.delivery.direct_degraded.abandoned: Direct delivery to the USSPs and the authority: not delivered after {attempts} attempts
ansp.alarms.label: Delivery alarms
ansp.alarms.title: Delivery alarms
ansp.alarm.kind.cisp_not_published: Active here, not yet published to the CISP
ansp.alarm.kind.delivery_abandoned: Delivery not achieved in its retry window
ansp.alarm.kind.occurrence_undelivered: Occurrence report not yet delivered to the authority
ansp.alarm.acknowledge_body: Your acknowledgement and its reason are recorded by the API. It closes this alarm; nothing is sent to the CISP, the DSS or a USSP.
ansp.alarm.acknowledge_body_stays: Your acknowledgement and its reason are recorded by the API. The alarm stays open until the condition clears; nothing is sent to anyone.
ansp.map.circle_centre_only_one: {count} circle is drawn as its centre: the API sends no outline of a circle.
ansp.map.circle_centre_only_other: {count} circles are drawn as their centres: the API sends no outline of a circle.
ansp.editor.title: Plan a restriction
ansp.editor.role: Only a watch supervisor plans restrictions; your role reads them.
ansp.editor.hint_polygon: Click the map for each vertex, or type one longitude, latitude pair (WGS84 degrees) per line. The ring is closed for you.
ansp.editor.hint_circle: Click the map for the centre and enter the radius in metres.
ansp.editor.vertices: Vertices: longitude, latitude per line (WGS84 degrees)
ansp.editor.vertices.pair: Line {line} is not a longitude, latitude pair.
ansp.editor.vertices.range: Line {line} is outside longitude -180..180 or latitude -90..90.
ansp.editor.centre_none: No centre yet: click the map.
ansp.editor.centre_required: click the map for the circle's centre
ansp.editor.agl_unavailable: AGL is not available: the API refuses it ("AGL is not supported for a dynamic restriction in this release").
ansp.editor.not_sent: not sent: the confirmation was cancelled
ansp.editor.chain.title_one: The window is longer than one restriction may last: the API proposes {count} re-issue.
ansp.editor.chain.title_other: The window is longer than one restriction may last: the API proposes a chain of {count} re-issues.
ansp.editor.chain.confirm_hint: Tick "Plan as a chain" and plan again to plan them as linked restrictions; each is activated when its predecessor expires.
ansp.editor.cis_stale: Nothing can be planned while the CIS projection is stale or missing: the API must know the current U-space airspace.
ansp.editor.confirm.title: Plan this restriction?
ansp.editor.confirm.body: The API records the restriction as planned in U-space airspace {airspace} and publishes it to the CISP as planned (the regulatory channel). It is not active and nothing is written to the DSS until you activate it. {chain}
ansp.editor.confirm.chain: The window is planned as the chain of linked re-issues the API proposed.
ansp.editor.map_hint: Active restrictions are shown for reference. The API judges the area, its size, the limits and that it lies inside the U-space airspace.
ansp.field.uspace_airspace_id.hint: The identifier of the current USPACE feature the restriction lies in, as the CIS publishes it.
ansp.field.reason_text.hint: Why, as you state it; kept with the restriction and published in its ED-318 message.
ansp.field.confirm_chain.hint: Only when the API proposed a chain of re-issues for a long window.
ansp.detail.acts_role: The acts on a restriction are a watch supervisor's; your role reads it.
ansp.detail.reference_none: Not in the DSS yet: the reference exists once the DSS accepts the first write.
ansp.act.activate_body: {identifier} becomes active now, or at {starts} if that is later, until {ends}. The API then publishes the activation to the CISP (the regulatory channel) and writes the F3548 constraint to the DSS, which tells the subscribed USSPs. Your reason is recorded.
ansp.act.extend_body: {identifier} (v{version}) gets the new end {new_ends}. The API publishes the new version to the CISP and, while it is active, writes it to the DSS; beyond the longest duration of one restriction it makes a linked re-issue instead. Your reason is recorded.
ansp.act.end_body: {identifier} ends now instead of at {ends}. The API publishes the end to the CISP and deletes the constraint from the DSS, which tells the subscribed USSPs. Your reason is recorded.
ansp.act.cancel_body: {identifier} was never activated and is withdrawn. The API publishes the cancellation to the CISP; nothing was written to the DSS. Your reason is recorded.
ansp.requests.title: Restriction requests
ansp.requests.no_list: The API has no list of requests yet: open a request by the id its requester gave.
ansp.requests.accept_body: The API plans the restriction exactly as requested ({zone_type}, {starts} to {ends}, in {airspace}) and publishes it to the CISP as planned; {requester} reads that it was accepted. It is not active until you activate it. Your reason is recorded.
ansp.requests.decline_body: No restriction is planned. {requester} reads your reason; nothing is sent to the CISP or the DSS.
ansp.adapters.title: Surveillance adapters
ansp.adapters.none: No adapter is configured: the manned picture has no source.
ansp.adapters.sources_unavailable: Who disabled an adapter and why cannot be read now:
ansp.adapters.status.disabled_type: Disabled with every manned source by {actor} at {at}: {reason}
ansp.adapters.status.disabled_unknown: Disabled; the switch that disabled it is not in the source list
ansp.picture.title: Manned traffic picture
ansp.picture.state.source_disabled_type: Source disabled by {who} for every manned source ({age})
ansp.picture.state.source_disabled_unkno: Source {adapter} disabled; the feed does not say by whom ({age})
ansp.picture.relevance.relevant: relevant: in U-space airspace or its margin
ansp.picture.relevance.other: outside U-space airspace and its margin
ansp.picture.relevance.unstated: relevance not stated by the feed
ansp.picture.adapter.disabled_unknown: {id}: disabled; by whom is not stated
ansp.picture.status.label: Manned stream status
ansp.picture.status.down: Manned traffic stream down since {since}: the aircraft are shown as last received.
ansp.picture.status.silent: No status from the stream for {age} (stale after {threshold} s): the picture may be behind.
ansp.picture.status.policy: Policy version {version} · stale after {stale} s · live up to {live} s
ansp.picture.status.cis_none: No CIS projection: relevance is not evaluated
ansp.picture.status.counters: Not shown: {refused} refused frames, {out_of_order} older than the one held, {evicted} evicted past the bound, {adapters} malformed adapter entries
ansp.picture.held_one: Stream not live: {count} aircraft is shown at its last position with its age.
ansp.picture.held_other: Stream not live: {count} aircraft are shown at their last positions with their ages.
ansp.picture.map_note: Each aircraft is drawn at its last reported position and never moved by the console. Square: surveillance; ringed and larger: relevant to U-space airspace; faded: stale or its source disabled.
ansp.picture.unavailable: Manned traffic unavailable since {since}: the stream is down.
ansp.picture.connecting: Connecting to the manned traffic stream…
ansp.status.coordination.down: Coordination stream down since {since}: new notices and escalations may not be shown until it returns.
ansp.inbox.title: Coordination inbox (Annex V)
ansp.inbox.notification.title: Escalated coordination notice
ansp.inbox.ack_conflict: Acknowledged already, by someone else first: the inbox was read again.
ansp.inbox.sender_unverified: Sender not verified: no CIS USSP list was projected when it arrived.
ansp.inbox.intents_malformed_one: {count} intent of the payload could not be read and is not shown.
ansp.inbox.intents_malformed_other: {count} intents of the payload could not be read and are not shown.
ansp.inbox.restrictions_none: Touches no planned or active restriction (as the API computed at receipt).
ansp.inbox.ack_role: A watch supervisor acknowledges notices; your role reads them.
ansp.inbox.notify.unsupported: This browser shows no notifications; escalations are shown on every page.
ansp.inbox.notify.denied: Notifications are blocked for this console in the browser; escalations are shown on every page.
ansp.inbox.notify.start: Notify me of escalations in this browser
ansp.inbox.notify.stop: Stop escalation notifications in this browser

ansp.inbox.truncated: The API holds more notices than it listed; the oldest are not shown.
